investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-14T10:54–11:01Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler with "Unschedulable": 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the agent pod never left the Pending state, so the eval contract could not be satisfied.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry that resource type. The other 4 nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector constraints on the remote-agent pod spec. Preemption could not help because no lower-priority victims were found on the 2 eligible nodes and preemption is not applicable to the 4 affinity-mismatched nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod submitted during the eval window remained Unschedulable for 134–148 seconds before the eval timed out, producing zero evidence and a full contract gap. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-07-14T10:54–11:01Z because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was rejected by the Kubernetes scheduler with "Unschedulable": 2 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the agent pod never left the Pending state, so the eval contract could not be satisfied.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature (production-api environment) has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry that resource type. The other 4 nodes are ineligible due to node affinity or selector constraints on the remote-agent pod spec. Preemption could not help because no lower-priority victims were found on the 2 eligible nodes and preemption is not applicable to the 4 affinity-mismatched nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod submitted during the eval window remained Unschedulable for 134–148 seconds before the eval timed out, producing zero evidence and a full contract gap. This is an eval-detected infrastructure capacity constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

Secondary — node affinity/selector misconfiguration or drift: the 4 remaining nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity or nodeSelector, meaning the schedulable pool is effectively limited to 2 nodes. If those 2 nodes lost capacity, the entire feature becomes unschedulable.

Tertiary — cluster under-provisioning: the 6-node cluster may not have enough kata.peerpods.io/vm-capable nodes to absorb concurrent remote-agent eval probes plus any production workloads sharing the same resource.

Lower confidence — a recent change to the pod spec's node affinity or resource requests could have tightened scheduling constraints, but sourceDiscovery.suspectChanges is empty and no pod-spec changes appear in the supplied evidence, so this remains speculative.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 3 Remote-Agent Checks
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment between 10:56 and 11:01 UTC on 2026-07-14 with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the eval's remote-agent pod because the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource reported it as exhausted, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. No evidence was returned by any check, meaning the agent pod never started and the runtime response contract was never exercised.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote-agent pod on any of the 6 available cluster nodes. Two nodes that carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity (0 allocatable slots remaining), and the other 4 nodes were excluded by the pod's node affinity or node selector rules. Preemption was also unavailable on both resource-carrying nodes. Because the pod never became schedulable within the eval timeout window (~148 s for remote-agent-runtime), the probe exited with a scheduling failure before any agent API call could be made, leaving all required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, model, provider, message) empty. This is an eval-infrastructure / cluster-capacity failure localized to the remote-agent scheduling path in the production-api environment; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
